hero.title: Italian design, technical precision, and international vision for high-end interiors.

about.title: ABOUT US
about.text: MOCA Ventures is a specialized firm based in New York and Europe, providing design, engineering, development, and procurement services for European millwork and furniture for multi-unit residential developments, hospitality projects, and hotels.

portfolio.title: PORTFOLIO
portfolio.text: Our portfolio showcases refined residential, hospitality, and mixed-use projects where European craftsmanship, bespoke millwork, and carefully selected furniture come together to create elegant, functional, and enduring interior environments across international markets worldwide.

team.title: THE PEOPLE BEHIND MOCA
team.text: Our international team combines design expertise, technical precision, and industry knowledge to deliver exceptional projects from concept through installation.

letsTalk.title: LET’S TALK
letsTalk.text: Let’s talk about your next project and explore how our design expertise, technical precision, and international network can bring your vision to life.
